# Security Policy

We take security and vulnerabilities reports for the **GuardianMail AI** project seriously. If you suspect a security issue or find a vulnerability, please report it following this policy.

---

## 1. Supported Versions

We actively support and fix security bugs on the following version tiers:

| Version | Supported |
| :--- | :--- |
| **v1.4.x** | **Yes (Current Main Branch)** |
| **v1.3.x** | **No** |
| **v1.2.x** | **No** |

---

## 2. Reporting a Vulnerability

**DO NOT create a public issue** to report a security vulnerability. Instead, please report it via the following steps:
1. Send an email to **security@guardianmail.ai** with the subject: `Vulnerability Report: [Short Description]`.
2. Include a detailed description of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce, and a proof of concept (PoC) if available.
3. We will acknowledge receipt within 24 hours and coordinate a private patch within 7 business days.

---

## 3. Disclosures Policy

We follow responsible disclosure principles. Security advisories will be published on our GitHub Releases section once a patch is merged and released.
